question: Why must the doctrinal support for a one-spired bhadra be rejected in construction?
premises: The support of the opinion concerning a one-spired bhadra is considered.
This support is to be abandoned.
One should not construct according to that support.
inference: Construction should not follow the abandoned doctrinal support for a one-spired bhadra.
plain_english: Having abandoned the doctrinal support for a one-spired bhadra, one should not have it constructed.
